CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS llm_usage (
  day date NOT NULL, owner_id text NOT NULL, workflow text NOT NULL, model text NOT NULL,
  tokens int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, requests int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (day, owner_id, workflow, model));

INSERT INTO llm_usage (day, owner_id, workflow, model, tokens, requests)
VALUES ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc')::date, $1, $2, $3, $4::int, 1)
ON CONFLICT (day, owner_id, workflow, model)
DO UPDATE SET tokens = llm_usage.tokens + EXCLUDED.tokens, requests = llm_usage.requests + 1;
